name:
Jay
Etim
bio: Jay somehow found her way back to MT Committee for the third year in a row. She’s incredibly excited to spend more time with the society than on her degree yet again <3

name:
Keng
How
bio: Keng spent part of his summer looking at financial statements and accounting reports, naturally therefore it only makes sense for him to spend the rest of the year looking at glorified excel spreadsheets. He is looking forward to his final year in the society whether on stage, part of a directing team or on committee (he seems to be "just always there").

name:
Aoife
O'Kane
bio: Having only tried musical theatre for the first time in her second year, Aoife isn’t quite sure how she ended up here… but she’s thrilled to be here anyways! She’s super excited to reconnect with old friends and meet new friends!!! (and force everyone to read her brainrot emails ofc <333)

name:
Henry
Shen
bio: It's always too late for Henry to realise that he has signed up for an excessive amount of stuffs. As for MTSoc, that's when he's designing all of these committee intro posts.

name:
Bryan
Chan
bio: Bryan has had ENOUGH of Huxley and is ecstatic to have MTSoc as a form of escapism… He can’t wait to get back onto the Union stage and ridicule himself in front of all his peers again!

name:
Atom
Lucenet
bio: Atom tried getting into committee three weeks into his first term at Imperial - take that as a lesson that it’s never too early to get involved in societies! He is unbelievably excited to see new and old faces at socials and is unbelievably stressed about having to plan said socials 😊😬

name:
Nathalie
Tedfors Lindell
bio: Nathalie joined MTSoc in 2020 and has kept doing more degrees in order to stay for as long as possible. However, she has finally reached the end of this scheme, and is excited for one last year with the best society ever <3

name:
Frances
Jin
bio: Frances doesn’t have the luxury of time to commit to a good bio. Just DM her if you care to learn more about the person.
